knight:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single transparent in-game tactics map sprite, not a portrait or concept sheet.
Input image: character portrait reference. Preserve that character's face, hair, skin, clothing palette and modest medieval-fantasy identity; convert them into a compact FULL BODY pixel-art map sprite.
Mara, a 32-year-old female practical mercenary swordswoman. Sun-touched light skin, hazel eyes, chestnut-brown jaw-length short hair. Worn silver armor, brown leather shoulder strap, distinctive muted red scarf. Calm determined expression. Full-body Mara holds a short practical steel sword downward in her right hand and a small round worn wooden buckler on her left forearm. Red scarf, worn silver cuirass, short brown travel tunic, leather belt, dark leggings, sturdy brown boots.
Technical target: 96x128 logical-pixel sprite on 3:4 portrait transparent canvas. If larger physical output is necessary, render EXACT enlarged square pixel clusters as though a native 96x128 sprite was enlarged 8x nearest-neighbor to 768x1024. Entire character fits in logical x=12..84, y=10..119. Both boot soles on same logical y=120 baseline, center between feet x=48. 8 logical pixels transparent top padding and 8 bottom. Keep all weapons fully inside silhouette width.
View: three-quarter front facing slightly viewer-right, orthographic at slight high angle suitable for HD2D fixed-Y billboard map. Relaxed ready standing stance, legs visibly separate, feet planted, both arms anatomically coherent, large readable head about one-quarter of total body height, 4-head-tall tactical sprite proportions. NOT a side-view battle action sprite.
Style: crisp handcrafted-looking clustered pixel art, maximum approximately 32 colors, clean stepped pixels, readable simple fabric folds, no tiny painterly texturing, no soft airbrush, no smooth gradients. Restrained warm neutral local colors with gentle upper-left shading only; runtime lights provide scene lighting.
Transparent alpha outside the single character. Absolutely no ground, platform, oval foot shadow, cast shadow, glow, backdrop, text, border, extra characters, frame grid, captions or watermark. No diagonal weapon pointing far outside body. Original design only.
